'''Takekumateru no Mikoto''' (健隈照命, birth and death dates unknown) was a [[Kofun period]] noble and a notable leader of the '''{{ill|Suwa-no-kokuzo|ja|洲羽国造|qid=Q67499361}}'''. He is also known by the name '''Takekumateru no Mikoto'''.
